articles.summary: The new banking center is located in the CityPlace Tower,in the heart of West Palm Beach West Palm Beach, FL (April 14, 2022) – Amerant Bank, Florida’s bank of choice headquartered in south Florida, proudly announces the opening of its West Palm Beach Banking Center and Regional Headquarters Office. This strategic expansion reinforces Amerant’s commitment …
articles.title: Amerant Bank Continues South Florida Expansion with the Opening of new Palm Beach County Regional Office and West Palm Beach Banking Center
